reviews.title: Requires a subscription!
reviews.text:
Free to download but only gives you a 3 day free trial before requiring a subscription. 
It is fun to play with but at least half of the photos it generated that included hands and arms were very unnaturally wrong (3 arms, too many fingers, arms and fingers facing the wrong direction).

reviews.title: Requires sign up for subscription before you can try it…
reviews.text:
Sorry … any app that requires a sign up before trying is NOT trustworthy. 
Yes you can get “THREE DAYS” free !!!
… but even for that 3frre days… you have to sign up for a monthly subscription.
———
Edit….
After receiving a response saying I can use the app for free…
Dear App Developer
Maybe you should have let me use the app for free then… but instead I have to sign up for a 3 day free trial with a paid for subscription automatically starting 3 days after this.
Instead… I couldn’t use the app without having to sign up.
You might say it’s free… but having an unusable app on my phone for free doesn’t equate to free use.

reviews.title: Data collection?
reviews.text: This app refuses to add a cartoon effect to any image that does not contain a full face. If you have only partial or slightly obscured face such as the brim of a hat etc., it will not make a cartoon image. This makes me suspect that the app is more interested in collecting facial recognition data. It should be able to add a cartoon effect to a picture of a dog or a tree or anything else. But it definitely wants your face.
